answer_1.quote: Experiments conducted on ASR, speech translation (ST), speech-language understanding (SLU), and question answering (QA) demonstrate that our method... effectively improves LSM performance across diverse tasks.

answer_2.quote: For ASR, we evaluated the model using the LibriSpeech test-clean and test-other sets, adopting word error rate (WER) as the performance metric... for ST... employing the SacreBLEU score... for ER... using the Micro-F1 score... for KE and IC... Accuracy (ACC)... for the WebQA dataset, BertScore was used... for BoolQA, ACC was used.
